mapper.select: SELECT notification.id AS notification_id, notification.marker_id AS marker_id, marker.incident_id AS incident_id, marker.operational_period_id AS op_id, marker.police_phone_id AS police_phone_id, notification.notification_type AS notification_type, notification.status AS status, notification.version AS version, notification.created_at AS created_at, ( SELECT event.event_id FROM event_dispatch_job event WHERE event.source_entity_type = 'marker_notification' AND event.source_entity_id = notification.id ORDER BY event.occurred_at DESC, event.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS latest_event_id FROM marker_notification notification JOIN marker marker ON marker.id = notification.marker_id WHERE marker.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY notification.created_at ASC, notification.id ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO marker_notification ( id, marker_id, notification_type, recipient_rule, recipient_account_ids, recipient_police_phone_ids, notification_payload, status, version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{record.id, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{record.markerId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{record.notificationType}, #{record.recipientRule},
ARRAY[
CAST(#{accountId} AS UUID)
]::uuid[]
ARRAY[]::uuid[] ,
ARRAY[
CAST(#{policePhoneId} AS UUID)
]::uuid[]
ARRAY[]::uuid[] , CAST(#{record.notificationPayloadJson} AS jsonb), #{record.status}, #{record.version}, #{record.createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (marker_id) DO NOTHING
